# Usage meter

> Quota used, with thresholds that warn.

## Instructions for the AI agent

Add Usage meter to this project exactly as specified here.

1. **Setup first.** Look for `ui/styles/kit.css` in the folder the `@/` import alias points to (`src/` in most Next.js apps, otherwise the project root). If it is missing, apply the one-time setup first: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/setup.md
2. **Components it uses.** None: Usage meter only needs the files below.
3. **Create the files.** Create every file under [Files](#files) at its exact path, with exactly the contents shown. If you can run shell commands, the download script below does this in one go.
4. **Register the CSS.** In `ui/styles/kit.css`, add this line directly above the `@source` line, skipping any already there:

   ```css
   @import "./components/usage-meter.css";
   ```

5. **Use it.** `import { UsageMeter, usageMeterTone } from '@/ui/components/usage-meter';` See [Usage](#usage). Tell the user which files you created.

**Rules.** Copy every file verbatim: do not restyle, rename classes, reformat, "improve", convert to another styling approach (CSS modules, styled-components, inline styles) or add npm packages. React and Tailwind CSS v4 only. Keep `'use client'` lines where they are. If a file already exists with identical contents, leave it. Fetch this doc and the source files as raw text (for example with `curl`), not through a summarising web reader: the code must arrive character for character.

## Specification

### Component: Usage meter

How much of a quota is used ("7.2 GB of 10 GB"), with thresholds that shift the fill to warning and destructive colours, and an optional segmented bar with a legend. Server Component–safe (no state; the mount animation is CSS).

#### Anatomy
- Root `<div class="ui-usage-meter [ui-usage-meter-sm|-lg]" data-tone="default|warning|destructive" [data-segmented] style="--ui-usage-pct:N">`.
- `.ui-usage-meter-header`: `.ui-usage-meter-label` (id, names the meter) + `.ui-usage-meter-summary` (`aria-hidden`, holds `<span class="ui-usage-meter-used">7.2 GB</span> of 10 GB`).
- `.ui-usage-meter-track` with `role="meter"` > `.ui-usage-meter-fill` (width = total %) > one `.ui-usage-meter-segment` per category (`style="--ui-usage-share:N; --ui-usage-color:…"`), or a single segment without categories. Zero-value segments get `data-empty` (hidden).
- `.ui-usage-meter-footer`: `.ui-usage-meter-status` (icon + "Approaching limit") and `.ui-usage-meter-description`.
- `ul.ui-usage-meter-legend` > `li.ui-usage-meter-legend-item` (`.ui-usage-meter-swatch` + `-legend-label` + `-legend-value`).
- `children` render last (e.g. an upgrade link).

#### Props
- `value` (omit with `segments` to use their sum), `max` (required), `label`, `unit` ("GB"), `formatValue(n)` (default `Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { maximumFractionDigits: 1 })` + unit — fixed locale so server and client match).
- `summary`: ReactNode replaces the "x of y" text; `false` hides it.
- `thresholds`: `{ warning: 75, destructive: 90 }` in percent (defaults); `false` disables tones.
- `segments`: `{ label, value, color? }[]`; colour defaults to `var(--ui-series-N)` in order. `legend` (default true with segments).
- `size`: `sm` 4px · `md` 8px (default) · `lg` 12px track.
- `description`, `labels` (`of`, `warning`, `destructive`, `full`), `getValueText(value, max)`.
- `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` / `aria-describedby` go to the meter element, everything else to the root.
- Helper: `usageMeterTone(pct, thresholds)` returns the tone.

#### Behaviour
- `value` clamped to 0…max. `pct = used / max × 100`. Tone: `pct ≥ destructive` → destructive, `≥ warning` → warning, else default. At `used ≥ max` the status reads "Limit reached".
- Status text (with icon) appears only for warning/destructive, so colour is never the only signal.
- Segmented: fills keep category colours; the tone shows in the status text only. Single bar: the fill and the used number take the tone.

#### Visual rules
- Root: grid, gap 8px, 14px text. Label 500 foreground; summary muted, tabular numbers; used number 500 foreground (tone text colour on a single bar at warning/destructive).
- Track: pill, `color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-foreground) 9%, transparent)`, `overflow: hidden`.
- Fill: pill, `width: calc(var(--ui-usage-pct) * 1%)`, flex with 2px gaps; segments `flex: <share> 1 0%`, colour `var(--ui-usage-color, var(--ui-usage-tone))`. Tone fill: default `--ui-primary`, warning `--ui-warning`, destructive `--ui-destructive`; status text uses `--ui-warning-text` / `--ui-destructive-text`.
- Footer and legend 13px; swatch 8px square, radius 2px; legend values muted, tabular.

#### Motion
- Mount: the fill uncovers from the start edge with `clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0 round 9999px)` → `inset(0)` over `--ui-spring-smooth-duration + 160ms` on `--ui-spring-smooth`, 80ms delay (RTL mirrors).
- Value changes: `width` and `flex-grow` glide on the smooth spring; colours cross-fade over `--ui-duration`.
- Reduced motion: no mount animation; values jump.

#### Accessibility
- APG meter pattern: `role="meter"`, `aria-valuemin=0`, `aria-valuemax`, `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuetext` "7.2 GB of 10 GB (72%)" plus ", approaching limit" when relevant. Named by the visible label (or `aria-label`); the description is wired with `aria-describedby`.
- The visual summary is `aria-hidden` (the value text says it); the legend is a real list.

#### Acceptance checks
- `aria-valuenow`/`aria-valuetext` follow `value`; fill width ≈ pct of the track after the mount animation.
- 72% default tone; 80% warning with "Approaching limit"; 95% destructive with "Near limit"; 100% "Limit reached".
- Segmented: one segment per category in series colours, widths proportional, legend lists each with its value.
- Track heights 4 / 8 / 12px.

### `ui/components/usage-meter/usage-meter.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, useId, type CSSProperties, type HTMLAttributes, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';

export type UsageMeterTone = 'default' | 'warning' | 'destructive';
export type UsageMeterSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';

export interface UsageMeterSegment {
  /** Category name, shown in the legend. */
  label: string;
  /** Amount this category uses, in the same unit as `max`. */
  value: number;
  /** Any CSS colour. Default: the next data series colour (`--ui-series-1…6`). */
  color?: string;
}

export interface UsageMeterThresholds {
  /** Percentage at which the meter turns to the warning colour. Default 75. */
  warning?: number;
  /** Percentage at which it turns destructive. Default 90. */
  destructive?: number;
}

export interface UsageMeterLabels {
  /** Joins used and max: "7.2 GB **of** 10 GB". Default `of`. */
  of?: string;
  /** Status at the warning threshold. Default `Approaching limit`. */
  warning?: string;
  /** Status at the destructive threshold. Default `Near limit`. */
  destructive?: string;
  /** Status when the limit is reached. Default `Limit reached`. */
  full?: string;
}

export interface UsageMeterProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'children'> {
  /** Amount used. Omit it with `segments` to use their sum. */
  value?: number;
  /** The quota. */
  max: number;
  /** Visible name ("Storage"). Without one, pass `aria-label`. */
  label?: ReactNode;
  /** Appended to formatted numbers: `GB` gives "7.2 GB of 10 GB". */
  unit?: string;
  /** Format a number for display (replaces the default formatter and `unit`). */
  formatValue?: (value: number) => string;
  /** Replace the "7.2 GB of 10 GB" summary, or `false` to hide it. */
  summary?: ReactNode | false;
  /** Percent thresholds for the warning / destructive colours, or `false` for none. */
  thresholds?: UsageMeterThresholds | false;
  /** Split the fill into categories. The fill then keeps category colours; the threshold shows in the status text. */
  segments?: UsageMeterSegment[];
  /** Show the legend under a segmented bar. Default true when there are segments. */
  legend?: boolean;
  /** Track thickness: 4 / 8 / 12px. Default `md`. */
  size?: UsageMeterSize;
  /** Secondary text under the bar ("Resets on 1 December"). */
  description?: ReactNode;
  /** Text for i18n. */
  labels?: UsageMeterLabels;
  /** Screen-reader value. Default: "7.2 GB of 10 GB (72%)" plus the status. */
  getValueText?: (value: number, max: number) => string;
  /** Content after the meter, e.g. an upgrade link. */
  children?: ReactNode;
}

const DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS = { warning: 75, destructive: 90 };
const DEFAULT_LABELS: Required<UsageMeterLabels> = {
  of: 'of',
  warning: 'Approaching limit',
  destructive: 'Near limit',
  full: 'Limit reached',
};

// Fixed locale: the same string on the server and in the browser (no hydration mismatch)
const numberFormat = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { maximumFractionDigits: 1 });

const clamp = (n: number, min: number, max: number) => Math.min(Math.max(n, min), max);

/** Which colour a percentage maps to. Exported for custom meters. */
export function usageMeterTone(pct: number, thresholds: UsageMeterThresholds | false = DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS): UsageMeterTone {
  if (thresholds === false) return 'default';
  const t = { ...DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS, ...thresholds };
  if (pct >= t.destructive) return 'destructive';
  if (pct >= t.warning) return 'warning';
  return 'default';
}

/**
 * UsageMeter — how much of a quota is used ("7.2 GB of 10 GB"), with
 * thresholds that shift the colour to warning and destructive, and an
 * optional segmented bar with a legend. The fill grows in on mount (CSS only).
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const UsageMeter = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, UsageMeterProps>(function UsageMeter(
  {
    value: valueProp,
    max,
    label,
    unit,
    formatValue,
    summary,
    thresholds = DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS,
    segments,
    legend,
    size = 'md',
    description,
    labels: labelsProp,
    getValueText,
    className,
    style,
    children,
    'aria-label': ariaLabel,
    'aria-labelledby': ariaLabelledBy,
    'aria-describedby': ariaDescribedBy,
    ...props
  },
  ref,
) {
  const id = useId();
  const labels = { ...DEFAULT_LABELS, ...labelsProp };
  const format = formatValue ?? ((n: number) => (unit ? `${numberFormat.format(n)} ${unit}` : numberFormat.format(n)));

  const segs = segments ?? [];
  const segmented = segs.length > 0;
  // Rounded so float noise (3.4 + 2.9 = 6.300000000000001) never reaches aria-valuenow
  const raw = valueProp ?? (segmented ? Math.round(segs.reduce((sum, s) => sum + Math.max(s.value, 0), 0) * 1e6) / 1e6 : 0);
  const used = clamp(Number.isFinite(raw) ? raw : 0, 0, Math.max(max, 0));
  const pct = max > 0 ? (used / max) * 100 : 0;
  const tone = usageMeterTone(pct, thresholds);
  const full = max > 0 && used >= max;
  const status = tone === 'default' ? null : full ? labels.full : labels[tone];

  const labelId = `${id}-label`;
  const descId = `${id}-desc`;
  const statusId = `${id}-status`;
  const valueText =
    getValueText?.(used, max) ??
    `${format(used)} ${labels.of} ${format(max)} (${Math.round(pct)}%)${status ? `, ${status.toLowerCase()}` : ''}`;
  const describedBy = cn(ariaDescribedBy, description != null && description !== false && descId) || undefined;

  // Segment shares are relative to the fill, so the fill alone carries the total width
  const shares = segs.map((s) => Math.max(s.value, 0));
  const showLegend = segmented && legend !== false;

  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      data-tone={tone}
      data-segmented={segmented ? '' : undefined}
      className={cn('ui-usage-meter', size !== 'md' && `ui-usage-meter-${size}`, className)}
      style={{ '--ui-usage-pct': pct, ...style } as CSSProperties}
      {...props}
    >
      {(label != null || summary !== false) && (
        <div className="ui-usage-meter-header">
          {label != null && (
            <span id={labelId} className="ui-usage-meter-label">
              {label}
            </span>
          )}
          {summary !== false && (
            <span className="ui-usage-meter-summary" aria-hidden="true">
              {summary ?? (
                <>
                  <span className="ui-usage-meter-used">{format(used)}</span> {labels.of} {format(max)}
                </>
              )}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      <div
        role="meter"
        aria-valuemin={0}
        aria-valuemax={max}
        aria-valuenow={used}
        aria-valuetext={valueText}
        aria-label={ariaLabel}
        aria-labelledby={ariaLabelledBy ?? (label != null && !ariaLabel ? labelId : undefined)}
        aria-describedby={describedBy}
        className="ui-usage-meter-track"
      >
        <span className="ui-usage-meter-fill">
          {segmented ? (
            segs.map((s, i) => (
              <span
                key={`${s.label}-${i}`}
                className="ui-usage-meter-segment"
                data-empty={shares[i] === 0 ? '' : undefined}
                style={
                  {
                    '--ui-usage-share': shares[i],
                    '--ui-usage-color': s.color ?? `var(--ui-series-${(i % 6) + 1})`,
                  } as CSSProperties
                }
              />
            ))
          ) : (
            <span className="ui-usage-meter-segment" style={{ '--ui-usage-share': 1 } as CSSProperties} />
          )}
        </span>
      </div>

      {(status || (description != null && description !== false)) && (
        <div className="ui-usage-meter-footer">
          {status && (
            <span id={statusId} className="ui-usage-meter-status">
              <Icon name={tone === 'destructive' ? 'circle-alert' : 'triangle-alert'} size={14} />
              {status}
            </span>
          )}
          {description != null && description !== false && (
            <span id={descId} className="ui-usage-meter-description">
              {description}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {showLegend && (
        <ul className="ui-usage-meter-legend">
          {segs.map((s, i) => (
            <li key={`${s.label}-${i}`} className="ui-usage-meter-legend-item">
              <span
                className="ui-usage-meter-swatch"
                aria-hidden="true"
                style={{ '--ui-usage-color': s.color ?? `var(--ui-series-${(i % 6) + 1})` } as CSSProperties}
              />
              <span className="ui-usage-meter-legend-label">{s.label}</span>
              <span className="ui-usage-meter-legend-value">{format(Math.max(s.value, 0))}</span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}

      {children}
    </div>
  );
});
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/usage-meter.css`

```css
/* Usage meter --------------------------------------------------------------
   <div class="ui-usage-meter [ui-usage-meter-sm|-lg]" data-tone="default|warning|destructive"
        [data-segmented] style="--ui-usage-pct:72">
     .ui-usage-meter-header  > .ui-usage-meter-label + .ui-usage-meter-summary (> .ui-usage-meter-used)
     .ui-usage-meter-track[role=meter] > .ui-usage-meter-fill > .ui-usage-meter-segment
                                         (style="--ui-usage-share:N; --ui-usage-color:…")
     .ui-usage-meter-footer  > .ui-usage-meter-status + .ui-usage-meter-description
     ul.ui-usage-meter-legend > li.ui-usage-meter-legend-item
                                (.ui-usage-meter-swatch -legend-label -legend-value)
   The fill is as wide as the total; segments share it by flex-grow.
   Mount: the fill uncovers left to right (clip-path) on the smooth spring.
   Value changes: width and shares glide on the smooth spring (never overshoots).
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@keyframes ui-usage-meter-grow {
  from { clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0 round 9999px); }
  to { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0 round 9999px); }
}
@keyframes ui-usage-meter-grow-rtl {
  from { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 100% round 9999px); }
  to { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0 round 9999px); }
}

@layer components {
  .ui-usage-meter {
    --ui-usage-pct: 0;
    --ui-usage-tone: var(--ui-primary);
    --ui-usage-tone-text: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    --ui-usage-height: 0.5rem;
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    font-size: var(--text-base);
    line-height: var(--text-base--line-height);
  }
  .ui-usage-meter-sm { --ui-usage-height: 0.25rem; }
  .ui-usage-meter-lg { --ui-usage-height: 0.75rem; }
  .ui-usage-meter[data-tone="warning"] { --ui-usage-tone: var(--ui-warning); --ui-usage-tone-text: var(--ui-warning-text); }
  .ui-usage-meter[data-tone="destructive"] { --ui-usage-tone: var(--ui-destructive); --ui-usage-tone-text: var(--ui-destructive-text); }

  .ui-usage-meter-header {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: baseline;
    justify-content: space-between;
    column-gap: 1rem;
    row-gap: 0.125rem;
  }
  .ui-usage-meter-label { font-weight: 500; color: var(--ui-foreground); }
  .ui-usage-meter-summary {
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .ui-usage-meter-used {
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
    transition: color var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  /* A single-colour bar repeats its state on the number */
  .ui-usage-meter:not([data-segmented])[data-tone="warning"] .ui-usage-meter-used,
  .ui-usage-meter:not([data-segmented])[data-tone="destructive"] .ui-usage-meter-used { color: var(--ui-usage-tone-text); }

  /* Track */
  .ui-usage-meter-track {
    position: relative;
    display: block;
    height: var(--ui-usage-height);
    overflow: hidden;
    isolation: isolate;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-foreground) 9%, transparent);
  }
  .ui-usage-meter-fill {
    display: flex;
    gap: 2px;
    width: calc(var(--ui-usage-pct) * 1%);
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-radius: inherit;
    transition: width var(--ui-spring-smooth-duration) var(--ui-spring-smooth);
    animation: ui-usage-meter-grow calc(var(--ui-spring-smooth-duration) + 160ms) var(--ui-spring-smooth) 80ms both;
  }
  [dir="rtl"] .ui-usage-meter-fill { animation-name: ui-usage-meter-grow-rtl; }
  .ui-usage-meter-segment {
    display: block;
    flex: var(--ui-usage-share, 1) 1 0%;
    min-width: 0;
    height: 100%;
    background-color: var(--ui-usage-color, var(--ui-usage-tone));
    transition:
      flex-grow var(--ui-spring-smooth-duration) var(--ui-spring-smooth),
      background-color var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  /* A segment worth nothing takes no room (and no gap) */
  .ui-usage-meter-segment[data-empty] { display: none; }

  /* Footer: status + description */
  .ui-usage-meter-footer {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    column-gap: 0.75rem;
    row-gap: 0.25rem;
    font-size: var(--text-sm);
    line-height: var(--text-sm--line-height);
  }
  .ui-usage-meter-status {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.375rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--ui-usage-tone-text);
  }
  .ui-usage-meter-status > svg { flex-shrink: 0; }
  .ui-usage-meter-description { color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); }

  /* Legend */
  .ui-usage-meter-legend {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.375rem 1rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
    font-size: var(--text-sm);
    line-height: var(--text-sm--line-height);
  }
  .ui-usage-meter-legend-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; min-width: 0; }
  .ui-usage-meter-swatch {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    width: 0.5rem;
    height: 0.5rem;
    border-radius: 2px;
    background-color: var(--ui-usage-color);
  }
  .ui-usage-meter-legend-label { color: var(--ui-foreground); }
  .ui-usage-meter-legend-value { color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .ui-usage-meter-fill { animation: none; }
  }
}
```

## Usage

**Storage** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/usage-meter/storage.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
import { UsageMeter } from '@/ui/components/usage-meter';

export default function UsageMeterStorage() {
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-sm">
      <UsageMeter label="Storage" value={7.2} max={10} unit="GB" description="Upgrade to Pro for 100 GB." />
    </div>
  );
}
```
